name: AdTripwire
description: Detect the threat behind the ad. Passive, local-only detection of advertising-based surveillance and spyware-delivery infrastructure. Observation and evidence only; no blocking. Chromium build: request metadata only, no response inspection.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; connect-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'
